selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is this passage mostly about?
questions.answer: It explains why the Risale-i Nur works so hard to help and protect faith.

questions.question: What question is being answered in the passage?
questions.answer: Why so much preparation is needed for defending belief.

questions.question: Why might someone think no more effort was needed?
questions.answer: Because such a small part already answered unbelief strongly.

questions.question: What picture is used to show that the problem is very big?
questions.answer: A huge fortress that has been damaged.

questions.question: Which three parts of many people are said to need help?
questions.answer: Their shared heart, shared ideas, and shared conscience.

questions.question: What human qualities are said to be in danger among many people?
questions.answer: Their thinking and their sense of right and wrong.

questions.question: What are the healing things used by the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: The Qur’an, belief, and the Qur’an’s miracle.

questions.question: What kind of remedies are needed for such big wounds?
questions.answer: Very certain proofs and very powerful cures.

questions.question: What does the passage compare the needed cures to?
questions.answer: Many medicines with great power to heal.

questions.question: Who is speaking in the first part of the passage?
questions.answer: A person asking why so much more effort is being made.

questions.question: How is the conversation introduced?
questions.answer: As a made-up exchange the speaker listened to.

questions.question: What was one reason the questioner was surprised?
questions.answer: A tiny portion of the work already seemed enough to answer very stubborn denial.

questions.question: How big are the stones in that image?
questions.answer: They are pictured as being as big as mountains.

questions.question: What does the passage say is inside that great fort?
questions.answer: Islam.

questions.question: What three religious helps are named for healing this break?
questions.answer: The Qur’an, belief, and the Qur’an’s miraculous quality.

questions.question: How long had harmful forces been getting ready?
questions.answer: For about a thousand years.

questions.question: What source gives the Risale-i Nur its healing power?
questions.answer: The miraculous Qur’an.

questions.question: What can believers keep doing with its help?
questions.answer: They can keep moving forward in faith.

questions.question: Why is the Risale-i Nur’s effort described as strong and active?
questions.answer: Because it is dealing with very serious harm to faith.

questions.question: What had impressed the questioner about the Risale-i Nur already?
questions.answer: Even a very small piece of it was very powerful.

questions.question: What two big things is the Risale-i Nur working for?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and showing His oneness.

questions.question: Is the work only for one person’s inner life or for many people too?
questions.answer: It is for many people too.

questions.question: What large symbol stands for the religion needing repair?
questions.answer: A fortress.

questions.question: What harmed these shared beliefs and feelings?
questions.answer: Strong tools of corruption prepared over a very long time.
